missing_contacts: zero by explicit user declaration; zero-coverage bins masked

loops.model: Negative binomial (Poisson at zero dispersion); raw counts; distance and balancing bias; leave-one-pixel-out moments
loops.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg over all tested pixels in this region
loops.limitations: Exploratory q-values: estimated mean/dispersion/bias, few background pixels, dependent tests and no biological replicates; no calibrated FDR guarantee.

domains.method: square insulation; within-distance permutation lower-tail test
domains.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg over all full-window boundaries in this region
domains.limitations: Candidate intervals, not validated TADs; exchangeability within distance ignores spatial dependence and does not preserve balanced margins.

reconstruction.limitations: Inferred population consensus under a contact-distance assumption; no physical distance calibration or experimental 3D validation. Orientation is arbitrary.
